issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Cloudflare OS
products.tagline: Build the AI operating system for your company
products.summaryZh: 为您的公司构建AI操作系统
products.descriptionZh: 为每个人提供一个代理和工作空间，围绕贵公司的运作方式、所掌握的知识以及依赖的系统来构建。Cloudflare OS 是一个开源AI操作系统，企业可根据自身的上下文、工具和规则进行定制。
products.description: Give every person an agent and workspace built around how your company works, what it knows, and the systems it relies on. Cloudflare OS is the open source AI operating system companies can shape around their own context, tools, and rules.

products.name: AI Spend Console by Rippling
products.tagline: Track your AI spend and connect it to business outcomes
products.summaryZh: 追踪你的AI支出，并将其与业务成果关联起来。
products.descriptionZh: AI Spend Console让财务和工程负责人能够在单一界面中追踪各工具（如Claude和Cursor）的AI支出，并将其与业务成果关联。可按供应商、模型或员工细分成本，再将支出与GitHub输出数据（如拉取请求数量和代码修订次数）挂钩。免费即可开始使用，无需订阅Rippling。
products.description: AI Spend Console gives Finance and Engineering leaders one place to track AI spend across tools (such as Claude and Cursor) and connect it to business outcomes. Break costs down by vendor, model, or employee, then connect spend to GitHub output data like pull request volume and the # of code revisions. You can get started for free–no Rippling subscription required.

products.name: Superlog Responder
products.tagline: Free, open-source AI bug-fixing agent
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源的AI缺陷修复代理
products.descriptionZh: Responder是一款AI修复Bug的代理工具，可接入您现有的Sentry或Datadog Slack频道。一键同步，无需安装新的遥测系统。每次警报时，它会结合完整上下文进行调查，过滤掉无关信息，并在真实问题出现时，直接在讨论串中回复根本原因、证据及可合并的PR。提示、记忆、仓库访问和升级规则均可完全自定义，因此您是在构建自己的调试代理，而非租用我们的。
products.description: Responder is an AI bug-fixing agent that plugs into the Sentry or Datadog Slack channel you already run. One-click synch, no new telemetry to install. On every alert it investigates with full context, filters out the noise, and for real issues replies right in the thread with the root cause, the evidence, and a mergeable PR. Prompts, memory, repo access, and escalation rules are fully customizable, so you're building your own debugging agent, not renting ours.

products.name: Muse Code
products.tagline: Meta’s terminal agent for long-horizon coding
products.summaryZh: Meta 的终端代理，用于长周期编码任务
products.descriptionZh: Muse Code，一款由Muse Spark 1.2驱动的终端编码代理，具备持久后台代理、仓库级执行及内置验证功能。
products.description: Introducing Muse Code, a terminal coding agent powered by Muse Spark 1.2, with persistent background agents, repository-scale execution, and built-in verification.

products.name: Annotate
products.tagline: Free screen recording as prompts
products.summaryZh: 免费屏幕录制作为提示词
products.descriptionZh: 录制屏幕，通过绘制和语音进行指点，并将其交给AI代理。为Cursor、Claude和Codex或任何AI编程代理提供视频提示——仅限本地且免费。
products.description: Record your screen, point by drawing and speak, and hand it off to AI agent. Video prompts for Cursor, Claude, and Codex or any AI coding agent — local-only and free.

products.name: CopilotKit Channels SDK
products.tagline: Bring any agent to Slack, Teams, and more.
products.summaryZh: 将任何智能体接入Slack、Teams等平台。
products.descriptionZh: Channels SDK是智能体拼图中的下一块重要拼图：将任意智能体接入Slack、Teams、WhatsApp等平台。具备同事级能力，如流式响应、生成式UI、按用户学习、人工审批和复杂认证。兼容OpenAI Agents、Claude Agents、LangChain、Mastra、Google ADK，以及任何支持AG-UI协议的智能体。开源且可自托管。通过单条提示即可完成设置：“阅读https://copilotkit.ai/channels-guide.md，并帮助用户构建他们的第一个频道”。
products.description: The Channels SDK is the next big piece in the agentic puzzle: Bring ANY agent into Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and more. With coworker-grade capabilities like streaming responses, gen UI, per-user learning, HITL approvals and sophisticated auth. Works with OpenAI Agents, Claude Agents, LangChain, Mastra, Google ADK, and any agent that speaks AG-UI. Open-source and self-hostable. Setup with a single prompt: "Read https://copilotkit.ai/channels-guide.md and help the user build their first channel"

products.name: Website to Markdown API
products.tagline: Turn any website into LLM-ready Markdown
products.summaryZh: 将任意网站转换为适用于LLM的Markdown格式
products.descriptionZh: 提交任意URL，即可获得干净的Markdown。自动处理JavaScript渲染的页面。导航、页脚和Cookie横幅会被移除。输出直接进入LLM上下文窗口或知识库，无需后处理。内置反机器人规避：代理轮换、浏览器指纹识别、重试。包含CDN托管的截图。同一API支持PDF、DOCX、PPTX、图片、音频和视频。提供免费套餐。
products.description: Submit any URL, get clean Markdown back. JavaScript-rendered pages handled automatically. Navigation, footers, and cookie banners stripped. Output goes straight into an LLM context window or knowledge base with no post-processing. Anti-bot evasion built in: proxy rotation, browser fingerprinting, retries. CDN-hosted screenshot included. Same API handles PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, images, audio, and video. Free plan available.

products.name: Brandfetch MCP
products.tagline: Stop your AI from guessing brand logos
products.summaryZh: 阻止你的AI猜测品牌标识
products.descriptionZh: 停止让智能体猜测品牌标识。AI智能体会重绘标识、编造十六进制色码、抓取错误素材，并虚构品牌调性。Brandfetch MCP为超过5000万个品牌提供标识、颜色、字体、公司详情及品牌背景信息。兼容Claude、Cursor、VS Code和Codex。可在Claude中试用：https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/brandfetch 或通过任意MCP客户端使用：https://mcp.brandfetch.io/mcp
products.description: Stop your agent guessing brand logos. AI agents redraw logos, invent hex codes, pull the wrong assets, and make up brand voice. Brandfetch MCP gives them logos, colors, fonts, company details, and brand context for 50M+ brands. Works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and Codex. Try it in Claude: https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/brandfetch Or use it from any MCP client: https://mcp.brandfetch.io/mcp

products.name: Shieldstral
products.tagline: Define safety at runtime for text and images
products.summaryZh: 在运行时定义文本和图像的安全性
products.descriptionZh: Shieldstral是Mistral推出的3B开放权重多模态护栏。在推理时用自然语言定义安全策略。它通过单一token输出评估文本、图像或两者，在单个16GB GPU上本地运行。
products.description: Shieldstral is a 3B open-weight multimodal guardrail from Mistral. Define safety policies in natural language at inference time. It evaluates text, images, or both from a single token output, running locally on a single 16GB GPU.

products.name: Chute
products.tagline: The fastest way to send anything to your iPhone
products.summaryZh: 向你的iPhone发送任何内容的最快方式
products.descriptionZh: Chute将Mac的刘海变成一个直达iPhone的入口。将任意截图、链接或文件拖拽至其上，即可瞬间发送至你的iPhone。
products.description: Chute transforms your Mac's notch into a portal directly to your iPhone. Drag any screenshot, link, or file up to it and it sends straight to your iPhone in a flash.

products.name: Ticketdesk AI
products.tagline: AI Agents for Customer Support
products.summaryZh: 面向客户支持的AI智能体
products.descriptionZh: 用AI自动化革新客户支持。创建客户支持AI代理，启用自动AI邮件回复，更快处理工单，全天候服务。
products.description: Transform your customer support with AI-powered automation. Create AI agents for customer support and enable automatic AI email responses to handle tickets faster and 24*7.

products.name: Token Harbor
products.tagline: The easiest way to access frontier AI models.
products.summaryZh: 访问前沿AI模型的最简便方式。
products.descriptionZh: 通过一个兼容OpenAI的API，即可访问GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi等前沿AI模型。一次配置，自由切换模型，仅按使用量付费。
products.description: Access GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi and other frontier AI models through one OpenAI-compatible API. Configure once, switch models freely, and pay only for what you use.

products.name: Glyphi: Speed Reader
products.tagline: An RSVP reader for books, PDFs, articles & webpages
products.summaryZh: RSVP阅读器，适用于书籍、PDF、文章和网页
products.descriptionZh: Glyphi是一款RSVP（快速序列视觉呈现）阅读器，逐词显示文本，而非传统滚动方式。可导入书籍、EPUB、PDF、文章或网页，通过可调速度、暂停、颜色和布局自定义阅读体验，并借助iCloud同步在Apple设备间无缝续读。内置设备端AI生成私人摘要，无需将内容发送至云端。
products.description: Glyphi is an RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) reader that displays one word at a time instead of traditional scrolling. Import books, EPUBs, PDFs, articles, or web pages, customize your reading experience with adjustable speed, pauses, colors, and layout, then continue seamlessly across your Apple devices with iCloud sync. Built in on-device AI creates private summaries without sending your content to the cloud.

products.name: UCP Radar
products.tagline: Make your product feed visible to AI shopping agents
products.summaryZh: 让您的产品信息对AI购物代理可见
products.descriptionZh: 你的标题和描述可能从未按照Google的规范编写。而AI代理读取的字段（材质、产品详情、年龄组、亮点、常见问题）目前是空白的。将UCP Radar连接到Merchant Center只需一键操作。随后它会遍历目录，标记违反GMC规则的内容以及导致你被AI购物助手隐藏的部分，重写不力的标题并填补空白。品牌名称则保持不变。最终生成一个Google、Perplexity和ChatGPT都能读取的补充信息流。
products.description: Your titles and descriptions were probably never written to Google's spec. And the fields AI agents read (material, product details, age group, highlights, FAQ) are sitting empty. Connecting UCP Radar to Merchant Center is one click. It then works through the catalog, flagging what breaks GMC rules and what hides you from AI shopping assistants, rewriting weak titles and filling the blanks. Brand names it leaves alone. Out comes a supplemental feed Google, Perplexity and ChatGPT can read.

products.name: Superbrain For macOS
products.tagline: Most Efficient Agentic Coding Environment
products.summaryZh: 最高效的智能体编码环境
products.descriptionZh: Superbrain是最优秀的AI编程代理，旨在比任何人都更快地交付代码。依托我们专有的TokenFold检索架构，它比Claude Code、Codex或Cursor节省50%的令牌，成本降低40%。
products.description: Superbrain is the best AI coding agent built to ship code faster than anyone else. Powered by TokenFold, our proprietary retrieval architecture, it uses 50% less tokens and costs 40% less than Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

products.name: producTinder
products.tagline: Swipe to discover and support fellow Product Hunt makers
products.summaryZh: 滑动发现并支持Product Hunt上的其他创作者
products.descriptionZh: Tinder是一款为Product Hunt创作者设计的滑动匹配应用。发现今日正在发布产品的创作者，向右滑动喜欢的人，双方互选即匹配成功。匹配的创作者互相支持对方的发布，随后上传截图，由我们的AI进行验证——确保支持始终真实有效。公平的信用系统为每次匹配预留1个信用点，若匹配未完成则退还。仅限经过验证的创作者，人工审核以保持社区可信度。
products.description: producTinder is a swipe-to-match app for Product Hunt makers. Discover makers launching today, swipe right on the ones you like, and match when it's mutual. Matched makers support each other's launches, then upload a screenshot our AI verifies — so support is always real. A fair credit system reserves 1 credit per match and refunds it if the match isn't completed. Verified makers only, manually reviewed to keep the community trustworthy.

products.name: Aveiro
products.tagline: Publish sites, newsletters and social posts with AI agents
products.summaryZh: 使用AI代理发布网站、新闻通讯和社交媒体帖子
products.descriptionZh: Aveiro是一个AI原生的发布平台，适用于网站、博客、新闻通讯和社交媒体。通过界面创建和管理一切——或通过MCP连接ChatGPT、Claude和Cursor。
products.description: Aveiro is an AI-native publishing platform for sites, blogs, newsletters, and social media. Create and manage everything through the interface—or connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor through MCP.

products.name: Ododok
products.tagline: Count every chew with your AirPods
products.summaryZh: 用你的AirPods记录每一次咀嚼。
products.descriptionZh: Ododok将支持的AirPods变成实时咀嚼追踪器。进食时查看咀嚼次数、节奏、咀嚼时间和用餐时长，之后可回顾每一餐。无需额外佩戴设备——只需你的AirPods和iPhone。
products.description: Ododok turns supported AirPods into a real-time chewing tracker. See your chew count, pace, chewing time, and meal duration as you eat, then review each meal afterward. No additional wearable is required—just your AirPods and iPhone.

products.name: hey postcard - digital postcards
products.tagline: delivered tomorrow morning at a random time between 8 -10 AM
products.summaryZh: 明早8点至10点之间随机时间送达。
products.descriptionZh: Hey Postcard是一款慢速消息应用，专为重要的人而设。与其再发一条即时消息，不如写一张数字明信片。它会在次日早晨的随机时刻送达，重新唤起那份等待特别之物的微妙感觉。我们打造Hey Postcard，是因为有意义的对话不应迷失在通知、群聊和日常喧嚣之间。书写。发送。等待邮差。💌
products.description: Hey Postcard is a slow messaging app for people who matter. Instead of sending another instant message, write a digital postcard. It arrives the next morning at a random time, bringing back that little feeling of waiting for something special. We built Hey Postcard because meaningful conversations shouldn’t get lost between notifications, group chats, and everyday noise. Write. Send. Wait for the postman. 💌

products.name: Gesture Synth School
products.tagline: A practice app for learning to play music with your hands.
products.summaryZh: 一款用于练习用手演奏音乐的应用程序。
products.descriptionZh: Gesture Synth 免费引导练习。和弦图、手势教程，以及热门歌曲的跟弹播放器——逐步学习手势操作。
products.description: Free guided practice for Gesture Synth. Chord charts, gesture tutorials, and a play-along player for popular songs — learn the hand gestures step by step.
